The digital dollar is the backbone of the ecosystem being built by the $WLFI team.

Its flagship product is a fully backed 1:1 USD-pegged stablecoin, anchored to the U.S. dollar and supported by U.S. Treasuries, held under top-tier institutional custody with BitGo.

But the real differentiation goes beyond structure — it’s transparency.

All reserves are backed by monthly third-party attestations. While some competitors provide annual reports or simple self-disclosures, $WLFI raises the standard with frequent, independently verified certifications.

In addition, they were the first stablecoin to implement real-time, on-chain proof of reserves powered by Chainlink, allowing anyone in the world to verify where reserves are held and confirm that every dollar is fully backed.

Verifiable transparency. Institutional-grade security. Trust built on data.

Beyond the technology, let the numbers speak.
